### CATLOADER V.2!

This is the BEST Disciple/+D file-handler, being a much-improved version of the one previously in OUTLET. It is very much faster to CAT the disc and selectively copy files, copying files up to 30K without reset (no limit under Betados). It includes a text reader for quick scan and print of text files, and a screen loader/display (with border colour change) — all automatic — just press a single letter key to load BASIC, SCREEN$ or text!

All commands use just one or two keys, making it the FASTEST and SIMPLEST file-handler we've seen! Supports one or two drives; selected file deletion; RENAME also changes case (e.g. "name.C" to "NAME.c").

Up to the full 80 possible files on any disc can be displayed on two pages (toggled by the SYMBOL key); BASIC programs are listed first, and different filetypes appear in different colours (which you can now customise to taste).

The new CATLOADER comes with a printed, easy-reference manual. It is on general sale at £6.99, BUT ONLY £3.50 TO OUTLET READERS!

A version for +3 is in OUTLET 33 (does not include RENAME or the colour-customisation of the +D version).

CHEZRON SOFTWARE  
34, Saltersgate Drive, Birstall, Leicester, LE4 3FF
